paragraphs: Signify sells lighting products, systems and services to professional customers and consumers. Its connected lighting offerings bring light and the data they collect to devices, places and people. The homepage says the company enhances public spaces, work places, and homes.

The case studies page presents Philips as the brand for professional and consumer lighting. It presents Interact as the Internet of Things platform and connected lighting systems. Color Kinetics appears there as the brand for dynamic architectural lighting systems.
Lighting Services are offered so that customers can leave the upkeep of their lighting to the company. Signify Lighting Academy is offered as a set of educational resources for lighting knowledge.
